title: Castelão
visualBrief: Specific Castelão stadium: native asymmetric oval roof/body and central aperture, closed pale membrane roof with darker translucent inner band and radial undersides, repeated tall tapered exterior lattice fins, curved perforated-metal envelope/west glazed frontage, two pale gray-green seating tiers/continuous risers/radial aisles/dark central hospitality band, closed neutral football floor/markings/goals, supported end boards and recessed closed lower entry groups. Six existing shared concrete/paint/perforated-metal/fritted-glass/window-grid/canvas graphs. Native access podium/holes/ancillary buildings remain independent context. No copied branding/live screen atlas, crowd, furnished hospitality/service interior, whole parking site or bespoke photographic textures.
